name: Default branch is protected
description: Every active repository protects its default branch from direct and force pushes.
remediation: Protect the default branch, or add a ruleset, so changes arrive through a pull request and force pushes are blocked.

controls.rationale: Shows changes reach the default branch only through review. It does not show who reviewed them or that nobody can bypass the rule.
Shows unreviewed changes cannot be pushed straight to production code. The approval itself is checked by the review checks.

name: Merges need an approving review
description: The default branch requires at least one approving review before a change merges.
remediation: Require one or more approving reviews in branch protection or the pull request ruleset.

controls.rationale: Shows a pull request needs an approving review before it merges. Whether each merged change was reviewed is checked separately.
Shows approval is required before a change merges.

name: Merged changes were reviewed
description: Every change merged into the default branch in the last 30 days was approved by someone other than its author.
remediation: Review the listed changes now and record it, then require reviews so a change cannot merge unreviewed again.

controls.rationale: Shows recent merged changes were approved by someone other than the author, which is the approval step of a change.
Shows peer review actually happened on recent merged changes, not only that it is required.

name: Checks must pass before merge
description: The default branch requires automated checks to pass before a change merges.
remediation: Add the test job as a required status check on the default branch.

controls.rationale: Shows tests must pass before a change merges. It does not show the tests are meaningful or that they passed on each change.

name: Secret scanning is on
description: Every active repository scans new pushes and its history for committed credentials.
remediation: Turn on secret scanning in the repository's security settings.

controls.rationale: Shows scanning is switched on for each repository. Rotating an exposed secret is a separate step.

name: Dependency alerts are on
description: Every active repository raises alerts for dependencies with known vulnerabilities.
remediation: Turn on Dependabot alerts in the repository's security settings.

controls.rationale: Shows dependency alerts are on. Container image scanning and fixing the alerts are separate.
Shows one source of vulnerability findings is switched on. The program also needs timeframes and tracking to closure.

name: Two factor is required for code access
description: The source control organisation requires every member to use two factor authentication.
remediation: In the organisation's authentication security settings, require two factor authentication for everyone.

controls.rationale: Shows two factor is required in the source control organization. Other systems need their own checks.

name: Code scanning runs on every change
description: Static analysis checks every change for injection and input validation flaws.
remediation: Turn on code scanning for each repository.

controls.rationale: Static analysis catches some input validation flaws. It does not show inputs are complete and accurate.

name: Stored data is encrypted
description: Every storage bucket, database, volume and snapshot in scope is encrypted at rest.
remediation: Turn on default encryption with a managed key for each resource.

controls.rationale: Shows every storage bucket, database, volume and snapshot in scope is encrypted, which is what the control states.

name: Endpoints require TLS
description: Load balancers and public endpoints accept TLS 1.2 or later only.
remediation: Set a TLS 1.2 minimum security policy on every listener and endpoint.

controls.rationale: Shows public endpoints accept only current TLS. Internal service traffic needs its own evidence.

evidence_kinds: Load balancer and endpoint TLS settings

name: Network rules deny by default
description: Security groups and firewalls allow only the inbound traffic a service needs.
remediation: Remove open inbound rules and allow only named sources and ports.

controls.rationale: Shows inbound rules are limited to what a service needs. The owner and purpose of each rule are reviewed by people.

name: No admin ports open to the internet
description: SSH, RDP and database ports cannot be reached from anywhere on the internet.
remediation: Close the port to the internet and reach it through a bastion or zero trust access.

controls.rationale: Shows SSH, RDP and database ports are not reachable from the internet, which is what the control states.
Shows the most dangerous inbound rules are absent. Other rules need review.

name: Accounts meet the hardening baseline
description: Cloud configuration passes the CIS foundations benchmark.
remediation: Fix the benchmark items listed on the result.

controls.rationale: Shows cloud configuration meets a benchmark. Operating system and container hardening need their own evidence.

name: Threat detection is on
description: A managed threat detection service watches every account and region in use.
remediation: Turn on the provider's threat detection service in every region in use.

controls.rationale: Shows the detection service is on in every account and region. Routing and response are separate.

evidence_kinds: Threat detection service settings per account and region

name: Encryption keys rotate
description: Customer managed encryption keys rotate at least once a year.
remediation: Turn on automatic yearly rotation for each customer managed key.

controls.rationale: Shows keys rotate. Who can use the keys and what happens on compromise need review.

name: Production is segmented
description: Production workloads run in their own network, with controlled paths between tiers.
remediation: Move production into its own network and restrict traffic between tiers.

controls.rationale: Shows production sits in its own network. The rules between tiers are reviewed by people.

name: Secrets live in a vault
description: Application secrets are held in a secrets manager, not in configuration or code.
remediation: Move the secret into the secrets manager and read it at runtime.

controls.rationale: Shows secrets live in a secrets manager. Access to them and their rotation need their own evidence.

name: Backups run and are kept
description: Every production database has automated backups with the retention the policy sets.
remediation: Turn on automated backups and set retention to the policy period.

controls.rationale: Shows automated backups with retention exist. Whether they succeed and are monitored is separate.

evidence_kinds: Backup settings and retention per database

name: Capacity alarms are set
description: Alarms fire before compute, storage or database capacity runs out.
remediation: Add utilisation alarms that notify the on call rotation.

controls.rationale: Shows alarms fire before capacity runs out. Forecasting and the actions taken are reviewed by people.

name: Audit logging is on
description: Every account records administrative activity to protected, retained logs.
remediation: Turn on the audit trail in every region and store it where it cannot be altered.

controls.rationale: Shows administrative activity is logged and kept. Application and sign in logs need their own check.

name: Configuration changes are recorded
description: Changes to cloud configuration are recorded and raise alerts.
remediation: Turn on configuration recording and alert on changes to sensitive settings.

controls.rationale: Shows configuration changes are recorded and raise alerts, which is what the control states.

evidence_kinds: Configuration change recorder settings and alerts

name: Root accounts use two factor
description: Root and break glass accounts have two factor authentication and no access keys.
remediation: Add a hardware or app based second factor to the root account and delete its keys.

controls.rationale: Shows the most powerful cloud accounts have two factor.

evidence_kinds: Root and break glass account settings

name: No broad admin grants
description: No user or role holds wildcard administrator permissions without a recorded need.
remediation: Replace the wildcard policy with the permissions the role uses.

controls.rationale: Shows no one holds wildcard administrator rights without a recorded need.
Shows administrator rights are limited and justified in the cloud.

name: Machine credentials rotate
description: Service account keys and access keys are younger than 90 days.
remediation: Rotate the key, or replace it with a short lived role.

controls.rationale: Shows machine credentials are rotated. Ownership and the inventory of accounts are separate.

evidence_kinds: Access key and service account key ages

name: Environments are separated
description: Production runs in its own account or project, apart from development and staging.
remediation: Move production into a dedicated account or project.

controls.rationale: Shows production is separate from development and staging, which is what the control states.
Shows production data is in a separate environment. Whether production data is copied out is not checked.

name: Build output keeps versions
description: Buckets and registries that hold build output keep versions and block overwrites.
remediation: Turn on versioning or immutable tags for the store.

controls.rationale: Shows build and pipeline storage keeps versions. Integrity checks between stages are separate.

name: Data is deleted on schedule
description: Storage lifecycle rules delete data when its retention period ends.
remediation: Add a lifecycle rule that matches the retention schedule.

controls.rationale: Shows storage deletes data when retention ends. Deletion from copies and vendors is separate.

name: Every system is in the asset register
description: Resources discovered in connected systems all appear in the Verity asset register.
remediation: Add the resource to the asset register, or record why it is out of scope.

controls.rationale: Shows discovered cloud resources are in the asset register. People, devices and SaaS need their own sources.

evidence_kinds: Discovered resources compared with the asset register

name: Two factor is enforced
description: The sign in policy requires two factor for every user, and every active user has enrolled.
remediation: Require two factor in the sign in policy and follow up with users who have not enrolled.

controls.rationale: Shows the sign in policy requires two factor and every active user is enrolled in the identity provider. Source control and cloud root accounts are checked separately.

name: Apps sign in through SSO
description: Business applications authenticate through the identity provider.
remediation: Connect the application to single sign on and turn off local passwords.

controls.rationale: Shows applications authenticate through the identity provider, which is what the control states.

name: Password policy meets the standard
description: Minimum length, complexity and lockout settings meet the password policy.
remediation: Update the identity provider's password policy to the company standard.

controls.rationale: Shows the identity provider enforces the password policy, which is what the control states.

name: Sessions time out
description: Idle and maximum session lengths are set within the policy.
remediation: Set idle and maximum session lengths in the identity provider.

controls.rationale: Shows session lengths are set within policy, which is what the control states.

name: Few administrators
description: Administrator roles are held only by named, approved people.
remediation: Remove administrator roles that have no recorded approval.

controls.rationale: Shows administrator roles are held by named, approved people. Reviewing that approval is separate.

name: Access lists export for review
description: Current users and their groups export for the periodic access review.
remediation: Connect the identity provider so each review starts from the live user list.

controls.rationale: Gives the list a reviewer certifies. The review and its sign off are done by people.
Gives the list used to find conflicting access. Judging the conflicts is done by people.

name: Access comes from roles
description: Application access is granted through role groups rather than to individuals.
remediation: Move direct assignments into the role group that should hold them.

controls.rationale: Shows access comes from role groups. Whether the roles themselves are right is separate.

name: Connected apps are known
description: Applications granted access through the identity provider are inventoried and approved.
remediation: Approve the application, or revoke its access.

controls.rationale: Finds applications connected through the identity provider. Purchases made outside it need another source.

name: Leavers lose access within a day
description: Everyone who left has no active account 24 hours after their last day.
remediation: Suspend the account now and find out why offboarding missed it.

controls.rationale: Shows accounts are removed for leavers on time. Returning equipment and handing over work are separate.
Shows no one who left still has an account after the allowed time, which is what the control states.

evidence_kinds: Account status in the identity provider

name: Joiners get access through onboarding
description: New starters receive accounts only after their onboarding checklist starts.
remediation: Start the onboarding checklist for the listed people.

controls.rationale: Shows accounts follow the onboarding checklist. Whether each step was completed is checked by people.

name: Everyone uses the company vault
description: Every active employee has a company password manager account.
remediation: Invite the listed people to the company password manager.

controls.rationale: Shows every active employee has a company password manager account, which is what the control states.

name: Changes trace to approved tickets
description: Production changes reference a ticket that was approved before release.
remediation: Link the change to its ticket and record the approval.

controls.rationale: Shows each production change links to an approval made before release.
Shows each production change links to a request that was approved, the first half of the trace from request to release.

name: Access requests are approved
description: New access is granted against an approved request.
remediation: Record the approval for the listed grants, or remove the access.

controls.rationale: Shows new access matches an approved request, which is what the control states.

name: Failures are tracked to closure
description: Control failures and audit findings open a ticket that closes within its SLA.
remediation: Open or update the ticket and agree a date to close it.

controls.rationale: Shows failures open a ticket that closes in time. Telling the right people is separate.

evidence_kinds: Remediation tickets and their closure dates

name: Security alerts page someone
description: Security alerts route to an on call rotation, not an unread inbox.
remediation: Route the security alert source to an escalation policy.

controls.rationale: Shows alerts go to an on call rotation. Tuning and acting on alerts are separate.

evidence_kinds: Alert routing and on call schedule

name: Alerts are acknowledged in time
description: High severity alerts are acknowledged within the response target.
remediation: Review the missed alerts and adjust the rotation or escalation.

controls.rationale: Shows alerts are picked up in time. The evaluation decision is recorded by people.

name: Incidents close with a timeline
description: Incidents are resolved with an owner and a recorded timeline.
remediation: Add the owner and timeline to the listed incidents.

controls.rationale: Shows incidents end with an owner and a timeline. The recovery steps themselves are separate.

name: Web traffic is filtered
description: A web application firewall and DDoS protection sit in front of public applications.
remediation: Turn on the managed firewall rules for the zone.

controls.rationale: Shows a web application firewall and DDoS protection sit in front of public applications, which is what the control states.
A firewall filters some malformed input. It is not validation inside the application.

evidence_kinds: Web application firewall and DDoS settings

name: Private systems need a trusted device
description: Internal systems are reachable only through the VPN or zero trust network.
remediation: Put the system behind the zero trust network and remove public access.

controls.rationale: Shows internal systems are reachable only through the VPN or zero trust network, which is what the control states.

evidence_kinds: Access policy and device posture settings

name: Edge TLS is current
description: The edge accepts TLS 1.2 or later and redirects plain HTTP.
remediation: Raise the zone's minimum TLS version and turn on HTTPS redirects.

controls.rationale: Shows the edge refuses old TLS and redirects plain HTTP. Internal traffic is separate.

name: Logs are kept long enough
description: Application and security logs are retained for the period the policy sets.
remediation: Raise retention to the policy period.

controls.rationale: Shows logs are kept as long as policy says. Completeness of what is logged is separate.

name: Unusual activity raises alerts
description: Monitors alert on error spikes, unusual traffic and failed sign ins.
remediation: Add monitors for the missing signals and route them to on call.

controls.rationale: Shows monitors exist for the main anomaly types. Responding to them is separate.

name: Processing failures are caught
description: Jobs and data pipelines alert when processing fails or falls behind.
remediation: Add failure and lag alerts to the listed jobs.

controls.rationale: Shows failed or late jobs raise alerts. Reconciling outputs to inputs is separate.

name: Capacity trends are watched
description: Dashboards and monitors track utilisation so capacity is added before it runs out.
remediation: Add utilisation monitors for the listed services.

controls.rationale: Shows utilization is tracked. Acting before capacity runs out is reviewed by people.

name: Systems are scanned monthly
description: Every in scope asset was scanned for vulnerabilities in the last 30 days.
remediation: Add the asset to the scan schedule.

controls.rationale: Shows assets are scanned on schedule. Fixing what the scans find is separate.
Shows assets are scanned for missing patches. Applying patches is separate.

name: Laptops are managed
description: Every company laptop is enrolled in device management.
remediation: Enrol the listed laptops.

controls.rationale: Shows every company laptop is enrolled in device management, which is what the control states.

name: Laptop disks are encrypted
description: Every managed laptop has full disk encryption turned on.
remediation: Turn on FileVault or BitLocker through device management.

controls.rationale: Shows every managed laptop has disk encryption on, which is what the control states.

name: Screens lock when idle
description: Every managed laptop locks its screen after the idle time the policy sets.
remediation: Push the screen lock profile to the listed laptops.

controls.rationale: Shows every managed laptop locks its screen after the set idle time, which is what the control states.

name: Operating systems are patched
description: Every managed laptop runs a supported, patched operating system.
remediation: Update the listed laptops.

controls.rationale: Shows laptops run a supported operating system. Servers and applications need their own source.

name: Lost laptops can be wiped
description: Every managed laptop can be locked and wiped remotely.
remediation: Re-enrol the listed laptops with remote wipe allowed.

controls.rationale: Shows devices can be wiped. It does not show a wipe was done when a device was lost or a person left.

evidence_kinds: Device remote lock and wipe capability

name: Endpoint protection is running
description: Every laptop and server runs a healthy, up to date protection agent.
remediation: Install or repair the agent on the listed devices.

controls.rationale: Shows every laptop and server runs a healthy, current protection agent, which is what the control states.

name: Production deployments are controlled
description: Production deployments run only from the default branch or a tagged release, and protected environments need a named approver.
remediation: Deploy to production from the protected branch only, and require approval on the production environment.

controls.rationale: Shows production releases follow a controlled path and need approval. Who is allowed to approve is reviewed by people.

name: Deployments are recorded
description: Each production deployment records the commit, the person or system that ran it, and the time.
remediation: Release through a pipeline or tool that records each deployment against its commit.

controls.rationale: Gives the release record an auditor samples.
Ties each release to the commit and change that produced it.

name: Required checks passed before merge
description: Every change merged into the default branch passed the required CI checks first.
remediation: Make the checks required, and stop merging while they fail.

controls.rationale: Shows tests passed on each merged change, not only that they are required.

name: Changes merged without review are reviewed afterward
description: Any change merged without the normal approval is listed, and each has a recorded review after the fact.
remediation: Review each emergency change after it ships, and record who reviewed it.

controls.rationale: Shows emergency changes are bounded and reviewed afterward.
Shows bypasses of peer review are visible and followed up.

name: Every active asset has an owner
description: Every active asset in the Verity inventory has a primary owner.
remediation: Give each asset a primary owner in Assets.

controls.rationale: Shows each asset has someone accountable for it.

name: Assets that hold data are classified
description: Every active asset that stores or processes data has a data classification.
remediation: Set a classification on each asset that holds data.

controls.rationale: Shows the inventory records what each asset holds.
Shows classification is applied to the systems that hold data.

name: Assets were reviewed on schedule
description: Every active asset was reviewed within the review cadence set in the asset settings.
remediation: Review each overdue asset and mark it reviewed.

controls.rationale: Shows the inventory is kept current.

name: Retired assets have a disposal record
description: Every retired asset has a decommission record with the method and sanitization.
remediation: Record how each retired asset was wiped or destroyed.

controls.rationale: Shows retired assets were disposed of with a recorded method.

name: Vulnerabilities are fixed within the SLA
description: No open critical or high finding is past its SLA without an unexpired risk acceptance.
remediation: Fix the overdue findings, or accept the risk with a reason and an expiry.

controls.rationale: Shows findings are remediated on time.
Shows missing patches are closed within the SLA.

name: Known exploited vulnerabilities have an owner
description: Every open finding on a vulnerability listed as known exploited has an owner.
remediation: Assign an owner to each known exploited finding.

controls.rationale: Shows the most urgent findings are not unowned.

name: Open risks are reviewed on schedule
description: Every open risk was reviewed within its register's cadence.
remediation: Review each overdue risk and record the outcome.

controls.rationale: Shows risks are reassessed through the year, not only at the annual assessment.

name: Risks above the acceptance band are treated
description: Every risk above the register's acceptance band has an owner and a treatment decision.
remediation: Assign an owner and record a treatment decision for each risk above the band.

controls.rationale: Shows each significant risk has an owner and a decision.
Shows significant risks have a treatment chosen.

name: Mitigated risks link to controls
description: Every risk treated by mitigation has at least one linked control.
remediation: Link each mitigated risk to the control that reduces it.

controls.rationale: Shows risks are mapped to the controls that mitigate them.

name: Risk acceptances are current
description: No accepted risk has an expired acceptance.
remediation: Renew or reopen each expired acceptance.

controls.rationale: Shows accepted risks are still accepted by someone with authority.

name: Vendors have an owner and a tier
description: Every active vendor has a business owner and a tier.
remediation: Set an owner and a tier for each vendor.

controls.rationale: Shows the vendor inventory records who owns each relationship and how critical it is.

name: Critical vendors are assessed on schedule
description: Every active critical or high tier vendor was assessed within its tier's cadence.
remediation: Run the overdue vendor assessments.

controls.rationale: Shows due diligence is repeated at the cadence the tier sets.

name: Vendors that hold personal data have a DPA
description: Every active vendor that stores personal data has a linked data processing agreement.
remediation: Attach the signed data processing agreement to each vendor.

controls.rationale: Shows agreements are in place where personal data is shared.

name: Required policies are published and current
description: Every required policy is published and was approved in the last 12 months.
remediation: Review and re approve the overdue policies.

controls.rationale: Shows policies are reviewed each year.
Shows the required policies exist and are in force.
Shows the secure development policy is published and current.

name: Staff acknowledged current policies
description: The target share of members acknowledged the current version of each required policy.
remediation: Send the acknowledgement campaign to the people who have not signed.

controls.rationale: Shows policies reached staff and were acknowledged.
Shows staff acknowledged the code of conduct.

name: Remediation tasks are within SLA
description: No remediation task linked to a control, finding or risk is past its SLA.
remediation: Close or re plan the overdue tasks.

controls.rationale: Shows deficiencies are corrected on time.

name: Every control has an owner
description: Every in scope control has an owner.
remediation: Assign an owner to each control without one.

controls.rationale: Shows each control has a named person accountable.

name: Controls rely on current evidence
description: No in scope control relies only on expired evidence.
remediation: Replace the expired evidence with current evidence.

controls.rationale: Shows controls are backed by evidence from the period, not from last year.
